```dataviewjs
// 文件墙：纯展示看板，不存储文件。素材按类型落在 Boxes 子目录，此处分四板块读取。

const SECTIONS = [
    { title: "🖼️ 图片", folder: "Boxes/图片", mode: "image" },
    { title: "📑 PDF", folder: "Boxes/PDF", mode: "pdf" },
    { title: "🎬 音视频", folder: "Boxes/音视频", mode: "media" },
    { title: "📎 附件", folder: "Boxes/附件", mode: "file" },
];

const RECENT_LIMIT = 12;

const getFilesInFolder = (path) => {
    const folder = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path);
    if (!folder) return [];
    const out = [];
    const walk = (node) => {
        if (!node) return;
        if (node.extension) {
            out.push(node);
            return;
        }
        const kids = node.children;
        if (!kids?.length) return;
        for (const child of kids) walk(child);
    };
    walk(folder);
    return out;
};

const collectAllEntries = () => {
    const entries = [];
    for (const section of SECTIONS) {
        for (const file of getFilesInFolder(section.folder)) {
            entries.push({ file, mode: section.mode, sectionTitle: section.title });
        }
    }
    return entries;
};

const fileMatchesDate = (file, year, month) => {
    const d = new Date(file.stat.mtime);
    if (year && d.getFullYear() !== Number(year)) return false;
    if (month && d.getMonth() + 1 !== Number(month)) return false;
    return true;
};

const formatDate = (mtime) => {
    const d = new Date(mtime);
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

const yearsFromFiles = (files) =>
    [...new Set(files.map((f) => new Date(f.stat.mtime).getFullYear()))].sort((a, b) => b - a);

const monthsFromFiles = (files, year) => {
    const set = new Set();
    for (const f of files) {
        const d = new Date(f.stat.mtime);
        if (year && d.getFullYear() !== Number(year)) continue;
        set.add(d.getMonth() + 1);
    }
    return [...set].sort((a, b) => a - b);
};

    .custom-search-input { flex: 1 1 200px; min-width: 140px; }
    .custom-filter-select, .custom-sort-select { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 88px; cursor: pointer; }

    .custom-recent-hint:hover { color: var(--interactive-accent); background: var(--background-modifier-border); }
</style>
`;

const renameFile = async (file, newBaseName) => {
    if (!newBaseName || newBaseName === file.basename) return;
    try {
        await app.fileManager.renameFile(file, `${file.parent.path}/${newBaseName}.${file.extension}`);
        new Notice("✅ 重命名成功");
        app.commands.executeCommandById("dataview:dataview-force-refresh-views");
    } catch (e) {
        new Notice("❌ 重命名失败");
    }
};

const deleteFile = async (file) => {
    if (confirm(`⚠️ 确定删除？\n"${file.name}" 将移至回收站。`)) {
        await app.vault.trash(file, true);
        app.commands.executeCommandById("dataview:dataview-force-refresh-views");
    }
};

const formatSize = (bytes) => {
    if (!bytes) return "0 B";
    const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
    let n = bytes, i = 0;
    while (n >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) { n /= 1024; i++; }
    return `${n.toFixed(i ? 1 : 0)} ${units[i]}`;
};

const iconFor = (file, mode) => {
    if (mode === "image") return "image";
    if (mode === "pdf") return "PDF";
    if (mode === "media") return "🎬";
    return (file.extension || "FILE").toUpperCase();
};

const COLLAPSE_STORAGE_KEY = "braincore-file-wall-collapse";

const getCollapseState = () => {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(COLLAPSE_STORAGE_KEY) || "{}");
    } catch {
        return {};
    }
};

const setCollapseState = (key, collapsed) => {
    const state = getCollapseState();
    state[key] = collapsed;
    localStorage.setItem(COLLAPSE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
};

const bindSectionCollapse = (section, sectionKey, titleEl, toolbarEl, bodyEl) => {
    const collapsed = getCollapseState()[sectionKey] === true;
    titleEl.addClass("custom-lib-title-text--toggle");
    titleEl.setAttr("title", "点击折叠 / 展开");
    const chevron = titleEl.createSpan({ cls: "custom-lib-collapse-icon", text: collapsed ? "▸" : "▾" });
    titleEl.insertBefore(chevron, titleEl.firstChild);

    if (collapsed) section.addClass("is-collapsed");

    titleEl.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const nowCollapsed = !section.hasClass("is-collapsed");
        section.toggleClass("is-collapsed", nowCollapsed);
        chevron.setText(nowCollapsed ? "▸" : "▾");
        setCollapseState(sectionKey, nowCollapsed);
    };

    if (toolbarEl) {
        toolbarEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
        toolbarEl.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    }
    if (bodyEl) {
        bodyEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    }
};

const renderEmpty = (body, mainText, hintText = "") => {
    body.empty();
    body.addClass("custom-lib-body--empty");
    const empty = body.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-empty" });
    empty.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-empty-icon", text: "📭" });
    empty.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-empty-text", text: mainText });
    if (hintText) empty.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-empty-hint", text: hintText });
};

const renderCard = (card, file, mode, metaExtra = "") => {
    const delBtn = card.createEl("button", { cls: "custom-delete-btn", text: "✕" });
    delBtn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); deleteFile(file); };

    const icon = iconFor(file, mode);
    if (icon === "image") {
        card.createEl("img", { attr: { src: app.vault.getResourcePath(file), loading: "lazy" } });
    } else {
        card.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-icon", text: icon });
    }

    const nameEl = card.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-name", text: file.basename });
    nameEl.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const input = document.createElement("input");
        input.value = file.basename;
        input.className = "custom-name-input";
        nameEl.replaceWith(input);
        input.focus();
        input.onblur = () => input.replaceWith(nameEl);
        input.onkeydown = async (ev) => {
            if (ev.key === "Enter") { await renameFile(file, input.value); input.blur(); }
        };
    };

    card.createDiv({
        cls: "custom-lib-meta",
        text: `${formatDate(file.stat.mtime)} · ${formatSize(file.stat.size)}${metaExtra ? " · " + metaExtra : ""}`,
    });
    card.onclick = () => app.workspace.getLeaf().openFile(file);
};

const buildFilterToolbar = (header, fileList, onChange) => {
    const state = { year: "", month: "", query: "", sort: "mtime-desc" };
    const toolbar = header.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-toolbar" });

    const row1 = toolbar.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-toolbar-row" });
    const searchInput = row1.createEl("input", {
        cls: "custom-control-item custom-search-input",
        attr: { placeholder: "🔍 搜索文件名..." },
    });

    const row2 = toolbar.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-toolbar-row" });
    const yearSelect = row2.createEl("select", { cls: "custom-control-item custom-filter-select" });
    const monthSelect = row2.createEl("select", { cls: "custom-control-item custom-filter-select" });
    const sortSelect = row2.createEl("select", { cls: "custom-control-item custom-sort-select" });

    const fillYearOptions = () => {
        yearSelect.empty();
        yearSelect.createEl("option", { value: "", text: "全部年份" });
        yearsFromFiles(fileList).forEach((y) => yearSelect.createEl("option", { value: String(y), text: `${y} 年` }));
        yearSelect.value = state.year;
    };

    const fillMonthOptions = () => {
        monthSelect.empty();
        monthSelect.createEl("option", { value: "", text: "全部月份" });
        monthsFromFiles(fileList, state.year).forEach((m) => monthSelect.createEl("option", { value: String(m), text: `${m} 月` }));
        if (state.month && ![...monthSelect.options].some((o) => o.value === state.month)) state.month = "";
        monthSelect.value = state.month;
    };

    [
        { v: "mtime-desc", t: "🕒 最新" },
        { v: "mtime-asc", t: "🕒 最旧" },
        { v: "name-asc", t: "🔤 A-Z" },
        { v: "name-desc", t: "🔤 Z-A" },
        { v: "size-desc", t: "📦 最大" },
        { v: "size-asc", t: "📦 最小" },
    ].forEach((o) => sortSelect.createEl("option", { value: o.v, text: o.t }));

    fillYearOptions();
    fillMonthOptions();

    const trigger = () => onChange({ ...state });

    searchInput.oninput = () => { state.query = searchInput.value.toLowerCase(); trigger(); };
    yearSelect.onchange = () => { state.year = yearSelect.value; fillMonthOptions(); trigger(); };
    monthSelect.onchange = () => { state.month = monthSelect.value; trigger(); };
    sortSelect.onchange = () => { state.sort = sortSelect.value; trigger(); };

    return {
        root: toolbar,
        apply(files) {
            let list = files
                .filter((f) => fileMatchesDate(f, state.year, state.month))
                .filter((f) => f.name.toLowerCase().includes(state.query));
            const [field, dir] = state.sort.split("-");
            list.sort((a, b) => {
                const vA = field === "name" ? a.name.toLowerCase() : field === "mtime" ? a.stat.mtime : a.stat.size;
                const vB = field === "name" ? b.name.toLowerCase() : field === "mtime" ? b.stat.mtime : b.stat.size;
                return dir === "asc" ? (vA > vB ? 1 : -1) : (vA < vB ? 1 : -1);
            });
            return list;
        },
    };
};

const renderSection = (container, title, fileList, mode) => {
    const section = container.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-section" });
    const header = section.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-header" });
    const titleEl = header.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-title-text" });
    titleEl.createSpan({ text: title });
    const badge = titleEl.createSpan({ cls: "custom-count-badge", text: "0" });
    const body = section.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-body" });

    const renderContent = (filtered) => {
        body.empty();
        body.removeClass("custom-lib-body--empty");
        badge.setText(String(filtered.length));

        if (!filtered.length) {
            renderEmpty(body, "暂无文件", "该分类下还没有匹配的文件");
            return;
        }

        const grid = body.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-grid" });
        filtered.slice(0, 120).forEach((file) => {
            const card = grid.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-card" });
            renderCard(card, file, mode);
        });
    };

    const toolbar = buildFilterToolbar(header, fileList, () => renderContent(toolbar.apply(fileList)));
    renderContent(toolbar.apply(fileList));
    bindSectionCollapse(section, title, titleEl, toolbar.root, body);
};

const bindRecentWheelScroll = (viewport) => {
    viewport.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
        if (viewport.scrollWidth <= viewport.clientWidth) return;
        if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) < Math.abs(e.deltaX)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        viewport.scrollLeft += e.deltaY;
    }, { passive: false });
};

const renderRecentStrip = (container, entries) => {
    const section = container.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-section" });
    const header = section.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-header" });
    const titleEl = header.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-title-text" });
    titleEl.createSpan({ text: "🕐 最近上传" });
    const badge = titleEl.createSpan({ cls: "custom-count-badge", text: "0" });
    const hintEl = titleEl.createSpan({ cls: "custom-recent-hint", text: "ⓘ" });
    hintEl.setAttr("title", "鼠标滚轮滑动查看");
    hintEl.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        new Notice("💡 鼠标悬停「最近上传」区域，滚动滚轮即可左右浏览", 4500);
    };
    const body = section.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-body" });

    const allFiles = entries.map((e) => e.file);

    const getFilteredEntries = () => {
        const paths = new Set(toolbar.apply(allFiles).map((f) => f.path));
        return entries
            .filter((e) => paths.has(e.file.path))
            .sort((a, b) => b.file.stat.mtime - a.file.stat.mtime)
            .slice(0, RECENT_LIMIT);
    };

    const renderContent = (filtered) => {
        body.empty();
        body.removeClass("custom-lib-body--empty");
        badge.setText(String(filtered.length));
        hintEl.style.display = filtered.length ? "inline-flex" : "none";

        if (!filtered.length) {
            renderEmpty(body, "暂无最近上传", "新上传的素材会出现在这里");
            return;
        }

        const viewport = body.createDiv({ cls: "custom-recent-viewport" });
        viewport.setAttr("title", "鼠标滚轮滑动查看");
        const track = viewport.createDiv({ cls: "custom-recent-track" });

        const paint = (target) => {
            filtered.forEach(({ file, mode, sectionTitle }) => {
                const card = target.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-card custom-recent-card" });
                renderCard(card, file, mode, sectionTitle.replace(/^[^\s]+\s/, ""));
            });
        };

        if (filtered.length <= 3) viewport.addClass("custom-recent-viewport--static");
        paint(track);
        bindRecentWheelScroll(viewport);
    };

    const toolbar = buildFilterToolbar(header, allFiles, () => renderContent(getFilteredEntries()));
    renderContent(getFilteredEntries());
    bindSectionCollapse(section, "🕐 最近上传", titleEl, toolbar.root, body);
};

dv.container.innerHTML = style;
const main = dv.container.createDiv({ cls: "custom-lib-wrapper" });
const allEntries = collectAllEntries();

renderRecentStrip(main, allEntries);

for (const section of SECTIONS) {
    renderSection(main, section.title, getFilesInFolder(section.folder), section.mode);
}
```
